candidates.label: HFIC-V12-C1-PIT-LIQUIDITY-RATIO
candidates.claim: PIT liquidity-to-mcap ratio at decision predicts H900 MEU.
candidates.mechanism: Decision-time liquidity thinness forces exit failure.
candidates.material_difference_from_prior: Uses PIT-ready ratio feature rather than historical reconstructible proxy.
candidates.disconfirming_prediction: Matched thick-liquidity cohort shows no MEU lift.
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: stratified MEU by PIT ratio bucket on offline panel
candidates.decision_unlocked: whether liquidity-ratio lane is worth Fast Lane experiment

candidates.label: HFIC-V12-C2-HISTORICAL-RETURN
candidates.claim: Historical 15m return reconstructs short-horizon path risk only.
candidates.mechanism: Post-decision reconstructed return is not strategy-available.
candidates.estimand: association of reconstructed 15m return with H900 MEU
candidates.material_difference_from_prior: Explicitly keeps HISTORICAL_RECONSTRUCTIBLE without PIT upgrade.
candidates.disconfirming_prediction: No MEU association after controlling for quote availability.
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: offline association table without provider calls
candidates.decision_unlocked: whether historical-only features can enter confirmatory reuse

candidates.label: HFIC-V12-C3-FORWARD-QUOTE
candidates.claim: Forward-only quote availability predicts later route disappearance.
candidates.mechanism: Observed quote failure class foreshadows exit withdrawal.
candidates.material_difference_from_prior: Keeps FORWARD_ONLY semantics orthogonal to PIT.
candidates.disconfirming_prediction: QUOTE_OBSERVED cells do not differ on later MEU.
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: bounded offline contingency on existing A1 receipts
candidates.decision_unlocked: whether forward-only quote truth can justify a data option

candidates.label: HFIC-V12-C4-UNRESOLVED-CREATOR-CLUSTER
candidates.claim: Creator-cluster attribution at decision predicts later withdrawal.
candidates.actor_counterparty: creator cluster versus LPs and late buyers
candidates.mechanism: Coordinated creator-linked wallets withdraw inventory before T+5.
candidates.estimand: effect of decision-time creator-cluster share on H900 MEU
candidates.material_difference_from_prior: Uses typed unresolved requirement instead of invented FEAT ID.
candidates.disconfirming_prediction: Unrelated service wallets with equal outflow show same MEU.
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: availability audit before any effect study
kill_if: stable FEAT ID invented without Catalog truth
candidates.decision_unlocked: whether creator-cluster remains a capability gap
